title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CIVIL GOVERNOR TO DIRECT ANY DISBURSING OFFICER OF THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT, OR OF ANY PROVINCIAL OR MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT THEREUNDER, TO WITHHOLD PAY FROM ANY PERSON EMPLOYED IN SUCH SERVICE WHEN IT APPEARS TO HIS SATISFACTION THAT SUCH PERSON IS INDEBTED TO ANY BRANCH OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT, AND REQUIRING DISBURSING OFFICERS TO COMPLY WITH SUCH DIRECTION.

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติมอบอำนาจให้ผู้ว่าการพลเรือนสั่งการเจ้าหน้าที่จ่ายเงินใดๆ ของรัฐบาลเกาะ หรือของรัฐบาลจังหวัดหรืออำเภอภายใต้รัฐบาลเกาะให้ระงับการจ่ายเงินเดือนแก่บุคคลใดๆ ที่จ้างงานในบริการดังกล่าว เมื่อผู้ว่าการพลเรือนเห็นว่าบุคคลนั้นมีหนี้สินต่อหน่วยงานใดหน่วยงานหนึ่งของรัฐบาลสหรัฐอเมริกา และกำหนดให้เจ้าหน้าที่จ่ายเงินปฏิบัติตามคำสั่งดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang yang memberi wewenang kepada Gubernur Sipil untuk memerintahkan setiap pejabat pengeluar dana Pemerintah Insular, atau pemerintah provinsi atau kotamadya di bawahnya, untuk menahan pembayaran gaji dari setiap orang yang dipekerjakan dalam layanan tersebut apabila menurut penilaiannya orang tersebut berutang kepada cabang mana pun dari Pemerintah Amerika Serikat, serta mewajibkan pejabat pengeluar dana mematuhi arahan tersebut
title.ms: Akta yang memberi kuasa kepada Gabenor Awam untuk mengarahkan mana-mana pegawai pembayar Kerajaan Insular, atau mana-mana kerajaan wilayah atau perbandaran di bawahnya, untuk menahan bayaran daripada mana-mana orang yang diambil bekerja dalam perkhidmatan tersebut apabila menurut kepuasannya orang itu berhutang kepada mana-mana bahagian Kerajaan Amerika Syarikat, dan menghendaki pegawai pembayar mematuhi arahan tersebut

text.en:
Whenever it shall be made to appear to the satisfaction of the Civil Governor that any officer or
employee of the Insular Government, or of any provincial or municipal government thereunder, is indebted
to the United States Government on account of the War Department, the Navy Department, or any other
Department of said Government, the Civil Governor is hereby authorized to direct the disbursing officer
through whom such insular, provincial, or municipal officer or employee receives his pay or salary, to
withhold such pay or salary to the amount of such indebtedness to the United States, and pay the same to the
officer of the United States Government authorized to receive the same.

Any disbursing officer who willfully fails or neglects to withhold pay or salary as directed by the
Civil Governor shall be deemed liable for the amount on his official bond, and in any case where such officer
or employee whose pay or salary is withheld under the provisions of this Act shall refuse or fail to sign
proper receipts to the disbursing officer for pay or salary due but withheld under the provisions of this Act,
the disbursing officer may take credit in his account for any such sum paid for the benefit of such officer or
employee, supporting such credit by a voucher reciting the order of the Civil Governor directing that such
pay or salary be withheld, and the receipt of the officer of the United States Government authorized to
receive the amount.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.

Enacted, September 29, 1903.
